description.narrative:
At the project level, IFC expects the proposed investment will facilitate the development of RE assets in Thailand and other SEA markets, which will supply the grid and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. The Sponsors pipeline includes 155 megawatts (MW) of solar capacity and 16 MW of wind projects in Thailand, estimated to generate up to 264,902 megawatt-hour (MWh) per year and avoid 109,405 tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO2eq) per year. Additionally, the Sponsor plans to build a 150 MW wind farm in the Philippines, potentially reducing emissions by 275,651 tCO2eq per year.
At the market level, IFCs investment would support the Group, a reputable Small Power Producer (SPP) in Thailand, in developing solar and wind projects totaling 171 MW, which represent 3.3 percent of the total RE capacity awarded in the big lot auction in 2022. This would position the Group as a crucial player in Thailands energy transition and enable it to compete in a dynamic market, with plans to expand further in SEA.

The proposed investment is a 15-year senior loan package of up to THB3,140 million, including up to THB1,570 million from the IFC A Loan and the remainder to be mobilized from one or two commercial banks as Parallel Loan(s) to Winchai Company Limited (Winchai or the Company), a wholly owned subsidiary of Sermsang Power Corporation Public Company Limited (SSP or the Sponsor). The IFC A Loan will be used for refinancing Winchai's existing seven-year US$ loan which had been provided for a 45MW operational wind power plant in Thailand. The proceeds of the Parallel Loan (s) will be partially used for refinancing the balance of the same existing loan, and partially will be distributed to SSP for potential use in the acquisition, development and construction of RE project(s) in other SEA market(s) in the future.
